title.zh: 将保和省比拉尔市镇阿莱格里亚街更名为胡安·卢纳街的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Alegria Street in the Municipality of Bilar, Province of Bohol, to Juan Luna Street
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Alegria Street in the Municipality of Bilar, Province of Bohol, to Juan Luna Street
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Alegria Street tại Thị trấn Bilar, Tỉnh Bohol thành Juan Luna Street
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Alegria Street ในเทศบาล Bilar, จังหวัด Bohol เป็น Juan Luna Street
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Alegria Street di Kotamadya Bilar, Provinsi Bohol menjadi Juan Luna Street
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Alegria Street di Perbandaran Bilar, Wilayah Bohol menjadi Juan Luna Street

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2833_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Alegria Street in the Municipality of Bilar, Province of Bohol, is hereby changed to Juan Luna Street.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
